categories.name: Backdrop Prop
categories.batchNote: Transparent background. These sit BEHIND the dog, so keep everything above y=1500 and outside a 700px-wide center column, or it will be completely hidden by the body. Think 'thing peeking out from behind the dog'.

categories.name: Fur
categories.batchNote: THE MOST IMPORTANT BATCH. Generate 'cream-floppy' FIRST, use it to build art/anchor-sheet.png, then generate every other fur with that sheet attached as a reference so head position and scale are identical. Ear shape is baked into this layer — it is the main dog-native trait.

layers.prompt: Thin diagonal pale blue rain streaks falling at a consistent 20 degree angle across the full frame at 45% opacity, evenly spaced, no puddles. Transparent background, full bleed 2048x2048.

layers.name: Confetti
layers.prompt: Thirty small flat rectangles and squiggles of confetti in pink, yellow, cyan and lime scattered and rotated randomly across the full frame, thin black outlines. Transparent background, full bleed 2048x2048.

layers.name: Scanlines
layers.prompt: Horizontal CRT scanlines: 4px dark grey lines every 12px across the entire frame at 22% opacity, plus a very faint vignette darkening at the corners. Transparent background, full bleed 2048x2048.

layers.name: Laser Glow
layers.prompt: A soft red radial glow centered on the eye line at x=1024 y=880, fading to fully transparent by 900px radius, at 35% opacity, with a few small red embers drifting upward. Transparent background, full bleed 2048x2048.

layers.name: Pixel Mode
layers.prompt: A full-frame pixelation and palette-crush overlay: a 32x32 grid of hard-edged translucent squares at 30% opacity in a 4-tone gameboy green ramp, plus thin scanlines. Turns whatever is beneath it into a retro handheld sprite. Transparent background, full bleed 2048x2048.
